name: releasepilot
description: Guided, evidence-based release automation for Salesforce managed 2GP packages.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: ReleasePilot only displays state in untrusted workspaces. Running workflow steps requires a trusted workspace.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Open the ReleasePilot dashboard to manage your Salesforce 2GP release.
[Open Dashboard](command:releasepilot.openDashboard)

releasepilot.coverageTargetPercent.description: Internal org-level Apex coverage target. Does not replace Salesforce's mandatory 75% package-version coverage.

releasepilot.logRetentionEntries.description: Maximum number of log entries kept in the persisted log.

releasepilot.allowDirtySource.description: Allow the Source Ready step to pass with uncommitted changes. Release candidates should normally be built from committed source.

releasepilot.ruleSelectors.description: Code Analyzer v5 rule selectors, e.g. Recommended, AppExchange, Recommended:Security.

releasepilot.severityGate.description: Untriaged findings at or above this severity block the pipeline.

releasepilot.testLevel.description: Apex test level for the Pre-package Tests step.

releasepilot.deployBeforeTests.description: Deploy the local package directories to the validation org (after confirmation) so tests exercise the current source. If disabled, test results cannot pass the gate.

releasepilot.testWaitMinutes.description: Minutes to wait for deployments and Apex test runs. A local timeout never cancels remote jobs.

releasepilot.installationKeyPolicy.description: require: every package version needs an installation key (asked at build time, never stored). allow-bypass: an empty key may be used after an explicit confirmation.

releasepilot.buildWaitMinutes.description: How long ReleasePilot tracks a package build locally. A timeout never cancels the build; retrying continues tracking the same request.

releasepilot.buildPollSeconds.description: Seconds between package build status checks.

releasepilot.stepTimeoutMinutes.description: Local wait timeout for a workflow step. A timeout does not cancel remote Salesforce jobs.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && node esbuild.mjs
